'''Drexel ''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. During the [[Galactic War]] he was posted on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]], where he was injured and asked an Imperial to defeat [[Valhoun's Vultures]] and [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Valhoun]] himself.<ref name="TOR" />
